experimental_design.purpose: Test the previously unsupported C2A 1pl past cell on preselected long-authorized class lemmas, scoring only explicit attestations and leaving unresolved targets unjudged.

independence_limits.reason: Green 2021 has contributed elsewhere in the project, so v16 is not a novel-source-family discovery benchmark. Its blindness comes from Git-verifiable target selection before answer lookup. Any post-freeze generic 1pl rule must still be authorized from an independent development source, not from the v16 buubinnay answer row.

notes: PR #46 merged the answer-free target registry before any 1pl answer lookup.
